snp5.1:20.6: the Sambuddha, the Supreme Human Being?”
snp5.1:21.1: “The Victor is in the Kosalan’s city, Sāvatthī,
snp5.1:21.2: he has much wisdom, excellent and great intelligence,
snp5.1:21.3: that Sakyan’s son, who is free from burden and pollutant,
snp5.1:21.4: that Bull of a Man has understanding of head-splitting.”
snp5.1:22.1: So then the brahmin addressed his students,
snp5.1:22.2: who were perfect in the the Vedas:
snp5.1:22.3: “Come, young men, and I shall explain,
snp5.1:22.4: please listen to this word of mine:
snp5.1:23.1: He whose manifestation in the world is always exceptional,
snp5.1:23.3: has now arisen in the world,
snp5.1:23.6: you can see the Supreme Human Being.”
snp5.1:24.1: “Having seen him how will we know that he is the ‘Buddha’, O brahmin?
snp5.1:24.3: You must tell us who do not know,
snp5.1:24.4: how we can know it is him.”
snp5.1:25.1: “There has come down to us in the the Vedas
snp5.1:25.2: the marks of a Great Man,
snp5.1:25.4: they are explained as thirty-two, complete in regular order.
snp5.1:26.1: For whoever has on his limbs

snp5.1:26.4: for a third cannot be found:
snp5.1:27.1: If he lives in a house,
snp5.1:27.2: when he has been victorious over this earth,
snp5.1:27.3: without a stick or a sword
snp5.1:27.4: he will rule according to the Teaching.
snp5.1:28.2: from the house to the houseless life,

snp5.1:29.1: About my birth, family, and marks;
snp5.1:29.4: you must ask in your mind.
snp5.1:30.1: If he should be a Buddha, one who sees without obstruction,

snp5.1:30.4: he will answer by way of speech.”
